front.title: Experimental Measurement of Human-AI Collective Cognition and Identity Continuity

abstract.t: This document describes an experimental framework for measuring collective problem solving by independently reasoning humans and computational agents. It separates strong task synergy, semantic coherence, state and identity continuity, provenance, authorization, and behavioral goal persistence. It proposes a controlled eight- condition study and reporting requirements. No new on-wire standard or consciousness test is asserted.
